title: A new trial begins with a question

captions.energy: Trying an unfamiliar way of caring
captions.emotions: Feeling open to an unfamiliar experience

meaning: Your new way of caring can leave room for a free trial when clarifying a need matters more than certainty that surprise must delight.
text: An unexpected gesture can open something new without knowing beforehand how it will be received. The Fool in Anahata’s energy position brings a wish to try an unfamiliar form of involvement without a prepared script. The Moon in the physical position shows actions among ambiguous impressions where a guess needs clarification. The Fool in emotions offers openness to an experience not yet tested. Beginning differently may feel intriguing while hearing an unforeseen answer feels awkward. Tenderness allows a trial without requiring delight in novelty or an immediate continuation that confirms both your initiative’s success and the unexpected gesture’s value.

For example, one notices the other’s interest in unusual paper and first suggests making decorations together. A question reveals a wish simply to try different folds without a finished object. **A free trial need not end in the imagined object.** Sheets can be shared without dividing work beforehand. New involvement answers today’s interest, while a living response does not become a promise of a large shared interest in gratitude for an offered possibility.

Difficulty appears if spontaneity excuses acting for the other without asking. Alternatively, openness requires continual fun without doubt. Care distinguishes interest from an accepted agreement. Something can be tried and direction changed without making either an unfinished sheet or another use of materials proof of ingratitude or insufficient trust in your wish to stay close.
